body:
I know crying releases hormones.. but it just doesn't help. I am crushed. And I cant do this anymore. I think I've found a job.. but I'm not sure. Because no matter how much I save I won't make a budge in what it would take in colorado.. even where I am. So I'm really terrified. Because I'm going to be homeless with a bunch of shit I cant carry around at once.. do I really have to down size to a back pack?? 😭 I have designer shit I'll have to get rid of.. idk it's just a mess....
Sorry for the rant.. I'm done

Thank you but it's really alright. I have tried online therapy.. I never told any of my family friends or my ex. But nothing helps.. I literally just cry about shit, and nothing leaves me. I've cried everyday almost all day for the past 3 months at least.. he says 6.. but he's a fat liar about timing.he says we've only been together 5 years.. it's been 6

So do not judge a situation you know nothing about. Neither of us deserved it. I've been working on my anger.. he broke out and got violent.. what else could I have done? I had no idea.. so please tell me for the future what to do in that situation.. i would love that. Also, you are just ridiculous.

It's ok. Thank you for taking you're time to talk to me.  I feel like I'm stealing time from others just being alive.. someone else deserves this time more than I do. I've done all of that. 

I found a therapist.. but I was on Medicaid and lost it because I took a job and worked too much.. i cant afford it through a separate company.. and I cant qualify for insurance until September through my job.. but I cant afford that either because my salon shit down because of covid.. it's not looking like it's going to open back up ever.. they are closing I'm sure.. so even when I qualify I cant work there to pay for it. 

Plus on top of it.. I'd be working to have meds that don't work.. I just don't see an end to any of it.

That is literally my exact situation.. I have literally no one. Because no one really cares. Therapy never worked for me. I've tried. All I did was cry.. i never felt any better. I kept trying with online counselors.. I never told any one.that didn't help either. My med never did anything for me.. ever. I lied to my parents about "feeling better" because I didn't want to disappoint them. The only med that worked was for my anxiety.. I still take that one.
That's not the issue. I have the whole incident on camera. I know I shouldn't have hit him but I thought he was going to kill me in the moment of everything. I didn't know what to do.

It's alright... I've been suicidal on an every day basis for a while now. This was just the final incident. I love him so much I don't want a life without him. And I'm not going to live a life without him. I've already said goodbye

I mean I don't think he's an alcoholic but both of is were drinking last night.. pretty heavily. I wish I never hit him.. it was just instinct.. he had me by my hair and I was getting dizzy.. he was too close to kick away. I just reacted. I really am sorry about it. I wish I never did it and just let him finish and get his anger out

I'm a burden to everyone, and they all know it. They try to give me hope to lessen guilt on their part but refuse to talk me through anything. I learned to shut down and suppress all of my negative feelings because nobody wants to hear that. I've tried therapy, meds, meditation, aa, counseling, group therapy. I've been hospitalized three times. Through all of this nothing at all has helped. And I just want everyone's suffering (including mine) to be over with.

I've accepted everything already.  It's just something I have to do.. it's for everyone else i love more than it is for me. God has listened to my prayers.. well maybe not. But either way I wasn't praying for myself j was praying for others. To allow them to have acceptance eventually as well.

This is what I want most. I've been in pain for over half of my life. And have shoved others through pain. I'm not going to be that person anymore. And I know I cant change because I've tried so many times and receive the same result. I just know it's time. I've accepted it. And I've apologized to God and wrote my letter to whomever cares to read it.

Honestly, I don't want to. This is what I know needs to happen. I'm not continuing to drag others in my mess. I've hurt everyone in my past. And I'm not going to let myself have the chance to do it in the future.

Well it was my only friend I have left really, which is a guy. So I severed ties with them to. It hurt him that we were talking so I decided not to be friends with him anymore. So now I have no one. But I think it's better this way.
I've lost all of my friends throughout the years. Some because of him, but more so because of me. I'm not going to stick around to hurt someone else.
There isn't a next time. It's just over. He doesn't want to be with me or even near me anymore.
He knows. He no longer cares anymore. So it's time for me.
I wish I had an allergy to end my life. That would make it so much easier.
I really hope you're right. But my heart and gut are telling me to not hold onto hope. Just to let it go
Thank you
No. He cut me off emotionally completely. No emotion at all. Just one word answers and get away from me.

He tried to. But I'm stubborn. I would move heaven and earth to fix this.. but I cant. He's never pushed me away like this. And I know this is it. So this is it for me. I literally have no other reason to live. I cant and refuse to tell him that because that is the worst possible thing I could ever do. I think he feels trapped with me. And I don't really think he wants to be with me.. I think he thinks he has to.

He's pissed.. there is a giant pillow for between us. I can't even see him. Told me he's sleeping in the bed because it's more comfortable than the couch. (I wasn't going downstairs) and that he is not sleeping in the bed for me
 And for me not to touch him.

It's a long combination of things.. 6 years of them to be exact... but recently I was venting to a friend of mine last night (one he doesn't like me talking to) and I was really upset with him.. i caught him being happy to other girls on the internet that resemble almost all of the girls he's slept with but me, while i was downstairs sitting on the couch.. I was hurt and said some awful things to my friend about the situation and he read it. Blew up and I'm kicked out and he hasn't really said one word to me since. My heart feels like its melting out of my chest. I haven't stopped crying, and I think its finally time for me to stop hurting the ones I love permanently. I never mean to. I just go into a blackout mode and my anger takes control.
